theme: 教材片語・中高階 750–850 第 36 群

items.colloc: in summary, we... 總結來說，我們... | to be in summary 簡而言之
items.distinct: in conclusion 結論是 | in brief 簡言之
ex: In summary, the quarterly performance met our expectations.
總結來說，本季績效符合我們的預期。
The manager provided a report in summary of the meeting.
經理提供了會議的總結報告。
In summary, we need to reduce operational costs immediately.
總結來說，我們需要立即降低營運成本。

items.colloc: act in turn 輪流行動 | in turn, affect... 進而影響...
items.distinct: by turns 輪流 | one by one 一個接一個
ex: High inflation, in turn, led to lower consumer spending.
高通貨膨脹進而導致了消費支出減少。
Each department head spoke in turn at the meeting.
會議中各部門主管輪流發言。
Improved efficiency will, in turn, increase our profit margins.
效率提升將相應地增加我們的利潤率。

items.colloc: excellent job opportunity 極佳的工作機會 | offer a job opportunity 提供工作機會
items.distinct: career prospect 職涯前景 | job opening 職缺
ex: This position is a great job opportunity for young graduates.
這個職位對於剛畢業的學生來說是很好的工作機會。
The company posted a new job opportunity on its website.
該公司在網站上發佈了一則新職缺。
He is seeking a job opportunity that offers international travel.
他正在尋找一個能有出差機會的工作。

items.colloc: start a job search 開始求職 | during the job search 在求職期間
items.distinct: job hunting 求職活動 | career development 職涯發展
ex: The job search process can be both challenging and rewarding.
求職過程既充滿挑戰又有所收穫。
She is focusing her job search on the technology sector.
她將求職重點放在科技業。
Networking is essential for a successful job search.
人脈對於成功的求職至關重要。

items.colloc: qualified job seeker 合格的求職者 | active job seeker 主動求職者
items.distinct: applicant 申請人 | candidate 候選人
ex: Every job seeker should tailor their resume to the company.
每位求職者都應針對公司客製化履歷。
The website provides resources for the modern job seeker.
該網站為現代求職者提供資源。
Many a job seeker struggles with the initial interview phase.
許多求職者都在面試初期階段感到困難。

items.colloc: keep track of expenses 記錄費用 | keep track of time 掌握時間
items.distinct: lose track of 忘記/失去聯繫 | record 記錄（動詞）
ex: You should keep track of all your billable hours.
你應該記錄下所有可收費的工作時數。
It is difficult to keep track of multiple ongoing projects.
要追蹤多個進行中的專案相當困難。
The software helps managers keep track of inventory levels.
該軟體協助經理追蹤庫存水準。

items.colloc: lean back in the chair 坐在椅子上向後靠 | lean back and relax 往後靠並放鬆
items.distinct: lean forward 向前傾 | recline 斜倚
ex: He likes to lean back while reviewing the financial reports.
他喜歡在檢閱財務報表時向後靠。
Please lean back and wait for the meeting to start.
請向後靠並等待會議開始。
She leaned back to consider the proposal more carefully.
她向後靠著以便更仔細地考慮這個提案。

items.colloc: light weight design 輕量化設計 | light weight material 輕量材質
items.distinct: lightweight（形容詞）輕的 | heavy duty 重型的
ex: This laptop is popular because of its light weight design.
這款筆電因其輕量化設計而廣受歡迎。
The team developed a light weight solution for portable devices.
該團隊為攜帶式裝置開發了輕量化解決方案。
These light weight crates are easier to move around the warehouse.
這些輕量貨箱更容易在倉庫內搬運。

items.colloc: show a lack of confidence 表現出缺乏信心 | suffer from a lack of confidence 因缺乏信心而苦惱
items.distinct: lack of confidence (拼寫修正) | low self-esteem 自尊心低
ex: The applicant showed a lack of confidence during the interview.
申請人在面試時表現出缺乏信心。
Lack of confidence can hinder your professional growth.
缺乏信心會阻礙你的職涯成長。
The team’s lack of confidence resulted in poor project results.
團隊缺乏信心導致了糟糕的專案成果。

items.pos: phr. 第一線員工；作業員
items.colloc: experienced line worker 資深作業員 | train line workers 訓練作業員
items.distinct: staff 職員 | executive 主管
ex: The line worker reported a safety issue to the supervisor.
作業員向主管報告了一項安全問題。
Our line workers are highly skilled in assembly techniques.
我們的作業員在組裝技術上非常熟練。
New line workers must complete a mandatory training program.
新進作業員必須完成強制性訓練計畫。

items.colloc: look for a job 尋找工作 | look for evidence 尋找證據
items.distinct: search for 搜索 | seek 尋求
ex: We are looking for a candidate with strong leadership skills.
我們正在尋找一位具備強大領導能力的候選人。
Management is looking for ways to cut unnecessary costs.
管理層正在尋找削減不必要成本的方法。
The marketing department is looking for new advertising channels.
行銷部門正在尋找新的廣告通路。

items.colloc: look into the matter 調查該事項 | look into the possibility 研究可能性
items.distinct: investigate 調查 | explore 探索
ex: The board will look into the causes of the decline.
董事會將調查業績下滑的原因。
We need to look into the new tax regulations carefully.
我們需要仔細研究新的稅務法規。
I will look into whether we have enough budget remaining.
我會去查一下我們是否還有足夠的預算。

items.colloc: look out for opportunities 留意機會 | look out for safety 留意安全
items.distinct: watch out 警戒 | beware 嚴防
ex: Look out for any errors in the final contract draft.
留意最終合約草案中的任何錯誤。
Investors should look out for signs of market volatility.
投資人應留意市場波動的跡象。
You must look out for your colleagues' safety in the factory.
你必須在工廠裡留意同事的安全。

items.colloc: look over the documents 檢查文件 | look over the proposal 審閱提案
items.distinct: look through 詳閱 | review 審核
ex: Please look over the report before the afternoon meeting.
請在下午開會前瀏覽一下這份報告。
He took a moment to look over the financial statements.
他花了一點時間檢查財務報表。
Could you look over my presentation slides for any typos?
你可以幫我檢查一下簡報投影片有沒有錯字嗎？

items.zh: 失去優勢；地位下滑；衰退
items.colloc: lose ground to competitors 輸給競爭對手 | start to lose ground 開始失勢
items.distinct: fall behind 落後 | lose advantage 失去優勢
ex: The company began to lose ground in the local market.
該公司開始在當地市場失去競爭優勢。
Our brand is losing ground to more innovative competitors.
我們的品牌正輸給更具創新力的對手。
We cannot afford to lose ground in this key industry.
在這個關鍵產業中，我們承受不起地位下滑的後果。

items.colloc: lose oneself in work 沉浸於工作中 | lose oneself in a task 埋首於任務
items.distinct: immerse in 沉浸於 | focus on 專注於
ex: He often loses himself in complex data analysis tasks.
他經常埋首於複雜的數據分析任務中。
She tends to lose herself in projects that require creativity.
她傾向於沉浸在需要創造力的專案中。
It is easy to lose oneself in the details of the budget.
人很容易沉浸在預算的細節中而忽略重點。

items.colloc: the package was lost in delivery 包裹在運送中遺失 | report an item lost in delivery 回報物品運送遺失
items.distinct: delayed in transit 運送延遲 | undelivered 未送達
ex: The client claimed that the parcel was lost in delivery.
客戶聲稱包裹在運送過程中遺失了。
We apologize that your order was lost in delivery.
我們很抱歉您的訂單在運送中遺失。
Check the tracking status if your shipment is lost in delivery.
如果您的貨物在運送中遺失，請檢查追蹤狀態。

items.colloc: maintain loyal customers 維持忠實客戶 | reward a loyal customer 獎勵忠實客戶
items.distinct: repeat customer 回頭客 | regular client 常客
ex: We offer special discounts to every loyal customer.
我們為每位忠實客戶提供特別折扣。
Keeping a loyal customer is cheaper than finding a new one.
留住忠實客戶比開發新客戶成本更低。
The company’s growth depends on its base of loyal customers.
該公司的成長取決於其忠實客戶群。

items.colloc: make a call to the office 打電話到辦公室 | make a tough call 做出艱難決定
items.distinct: make a decision 做決定 | telephone 打電話
ex: I need to make a call to confirm the meeting time.
我需要打通電話確認會議時間。
The manager had to make a tough call regarding budget cuts.
經理必須針對預算削減做出艱難的決定。
She will make a call about the project direction today.
她今天會針對專案方向做出決定。

items.colloc: make a commitment to quality 致力於品質 | make a commitment to the team 對團隊做出承諾
items.distinct: devote to 奉獻於 | promise to 答應
ex: The company made a commitment to sustainable business practices.
公司承諾採取永續的商業模式。
We must make a commitment to improving our customer service.
我們必須致力於改善客戶服務。
He made a commitment to finishing the report by Friday.
他承諾會在週五前完成報告。
